items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 3 July 2026 5:12am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 03 July 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A dry but cloudy start to the day, with a risk of patchy rain arriving later this morning, the risk continuing into the evening. Light to moderate westerly winds will back southwest this morning, then freshen this evening. Top temperature 17°C.

Dry with clear intervals developing overnight. Minimum temperature 14°C.


##Outlook##

Generally dry and cloudy tomorrow and Sunday, with moderate to fresh southwest winds easing during the evenings. Temperatures up to 18 or 19°C.
